interventions.description: Add a marked crossing with high-visibility paint and pedestrian-actuated warning beacons.

interventions.title: Install a Planting Strip
interventions.description: Create a vegetated buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair cracks and uneven sections of the concrete walkway to prevent trip hazards and improve accessibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing and Refuge
interventions.description: Install a signalized mid-block crossing with a pedestrian refuge island to allow safe passage across the wide arterial.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge
interventions.description: Installing a marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island to allow for safer, staged crossings of the wide roadway.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add user-actuated flashing lights to increase driver awareness of the mid-block crossing.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Leveling
interventions.description: Grind down or replace uneven concrete slabs to eliminate trip hazards and improve accessibility.

interventions.title: Road Diet / Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width or number of travel lanes to slow vehicle speeds and shorten the pedestrian crossing distance.
